claims.claim: A 2015 paper found superforecasters maintained high accuracy across hundreds of questions two years in a row after being culled into elite teams.
claims.episode_span: They maintained high accuracy across hundreds of questions and a wide array of topics, defying expectations of regression toward the mean two years in a row.
claims.source_title: Identifying and Cultivating Superforecasters as a Method of Improving Probabilistic Predictions
claims.supporting_quote: Defying expectations of regression toward the mean 2 years in a row, superforecasters maintained high accuracy across hundreds of questions and a wide array of topics.

claims.claim: The 2015 paper supports four explanations of superforecaster performance: cognitive abilities and styles, task-specific skills, motivation and commitment, and enriched environments.
claims.episode_span: cognitive abilities and styles, task-specific skills, motivation and commitment, and enriched environments
claims.source_title: Identifying and Cultivating Superforecasters as a Method of Improving Probabilistic Predictions
claims.supporting_quote: We find support for four mutually reinforcing explanations of superforecaster performance: (a) cognitive abilities and styles, (b) task-specific skills, (c) motivation and commitment, and (d) enriched environments.

claims.claim: A 2014 paper found training, teaming, and tracking improved calibration and resolution in a two-year geopolitical forecasting tournament among five university groups, and tracking used the top 2 percent from year one.
claims.episode_span: Training, team collaboration, and tracking improved both calibration and resolution.
claims.source_title: Psychological Strategies for Winning a Geopolitical Forecasting Tournament
claims.supporting_quote: Results showed that probability training, team collaboration, and tracking improved both calibration and resolution.
